phase_goal: Show all details for a site together: the standalone flat Datasets tab is removed and every dataset connected to a site (target manifest, evaluation, query packs, site profile, this site's inspection-history rows, and per-run DS1-DS4) is presented under the site with breadcrumb-preserved navigation. Non-site data (platform capability model + sector datasets) lives in a small Shared entry, and sites can reference a sector.
reason_generation_started: Operator: datasets for a Shopify site are shown as a standalone flat listing that ignores connections; all details for a given site should be shown together so internal connections are preserved (MDE evidence principle). Sectors are a future grouping; for now everything is per-site, with shared sector/platform data reachable separately. Operator approved removing the Datasets tab (option 3) with a small Shared entry, and asked to create sector data not tied to any site that sites can use.
standing_directive: OPERATOR DIRECTIVE (2026-07-15): do NOT trigger inspection runs and do NOT apply destructive cleanup. Validate against runs/datasets already on disk. Recorded as FND-GEN021-000.

functional: Opening a site shows a 'Data connected to this site' panel listing that site's manifest, evaluation, query packs, site profile, its inspection-history rows, and per-run DS1-DS4; each opens in the dataset viewer.
Every dataset opened from a site keeps a Sites > <name> > Data > <dataset> breadcrumb back to the site.
The standalone flat Datasets tab no longer exists; per-site datasets are not shown as an orphaned repo-wide list.
A Shared entry lists only non-site data (platform capability model + sector datasets); no site-specific dataset leaks into it.
At least one sector dataset exists that is not tied to a site and is referenced by the sites that use it.

A site's promotable dataset (its query pack) has an in-UI 'Promote to sector data' action; after promotion the dataset is shared under a sector in the Shared entry and other sites can adopt/use it. Another site can 'Use' the sector pack, and the sector's member list reflects it. No blocking browser dialog (window.prompt/confirm) is used for these actions.
usability: Interactive holistic walkthrough (as-a-user, no runs triggered, no destructive apply): navigate Sites -> a site -> open one of its datasets -> breadcrumb back; open Shared -> platform + sector data; all views coherent, no dead clicks, no orphaned flat dataset list.
Confirm no inspection is triggered during testing.
technical: validate:dashboard asserts the site-data API returns a site's connected datasets, asserts the Shared API returns only non-site data, asserts the flat Datasets tab is gone, and asserts a sector dataset exists and is referenced by a site; validate:gen13 and validate stay green; git diff --check clean; no run-inspection process spawned.

known_gaps_opened: Per-site query pack matching is by target_id prefix or matching site-profile domain; a query pack named unlike its site and lacking a matching domain field would not appear under that site.
Sectors group shared query packs and member sites, but there is no sector-level view yet that lists all member sites and their comparison; sectors are surfaced from a site and from Shared only.
